method: NAIVE. Written straight from the deposited text using only the writing-l4-rules skill. No pipeline, no coverage table, no probe record, no independent test pass, no human gate. One pass, no review.
edition_encoded: Advance Medical Directive Act 1996 (Singapore), 2020 Revised Edition, informal consolidation in force from 1 May 2023, as deposited at ../../registers/source-bundle/AMDA1996.txt
license: Apache-2.0 for the L4; the quoted statutory text is reproduced under the standing grant in SSO's Terms of Use cl.13 - see ../../SOURCE-LICENSE.md

checks.command: l4 run amd-cases.l4 ; l4 run amd-offences-cases.l4
checks.note: l4 run exits 0 even when an assertion fails, so the diagnostics are what was read.

scope: ss 2 to 21 - the whole Act except s 22, the regulation power, which confers a power and decides nothing. amd-act.l4 carries the decision procedures (who may make a directive, witnessing, the registration gate, certification of terminal illness, and the duty to act). amd-offences.l4 carries the savings in ss 11-13 and 17-18, the four offences in ss 14-16, the good-faith protections in s 19, the causation rule in s 20 and composition under s 21. The prescribed forms, the register, the regulations and every medical judgment remain facts supplied.
